in_sanskrit.name: Riddhima
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Riddhima एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Riddhima is a Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Riddhi' which means wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. This name is believed to bring abundance, success, and good luck to the bearer.
